examples.chinese: 謝謝！明天晚上六點來我家，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Xièxie! Míngtiān wǎnshang liù diǎn lái wǒ jiā, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: Thanks! How about coming to my place at 6 p.m. tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 我今天晚上要去同學家玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yào qù tóngxué jiā wán.
examples.english: I am going to hang out with my classmate at his/her place tonight.

examples.chinese: 學校的圖書館早上八點開，晚上九點關。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zǎoshang bā diǎn kāi, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: The school library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 姐姐每天晚上都讀書，她進步了很多。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, tā jìnbù le hěn duō.
examples.english: My older sister studies every evening; she has improved a lot.

examples.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸是老師，他很喜歡他的工作。他在餐廳工作，每天差不多都晚上十點回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuān tā de gōngzuò. Tā zài cāntīng gōngzuò, měitiān chàbuduō dōu wǎnshàng shí diǎn huí jiā.
examples.english: My dad is a teacher; he really likes his job. He works at a restaurant, and he almost always gets home around ten at night every day.

examples.chinese: 他每天早上去上班，晚上去上課，真辛苦！
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù shàngbān, wǎnshang qù shàngkè, zhēn xīnkǔ!
examples.english: He goes to work every morning and goes to class in the evening; it's really tough!

examples.chinese: B:好，沒問題？ A:我們明天晚上八點見。
examples.pinyin: B: Hǎo, méi wèntí? A: Wǒmen míngtiān wǎnshang bā diǎn jiàn.
examples.english: B: Okay, no problem? A: Let's see each other at eight tomorrow evening.

examples.chinese: 明天晚上學校有一個新年晚會，你會去參加嗎？
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshang xuéxiào yǒu yī gè xīnnián wǎnhuì, nǐ huì qù cānjiā ma?
examples.english: Tomorrow evening the school has a New Year evening event, will you go to participate?

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 從昨天晚上到現在，已經下了十個小時的雨了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zuótiān wǎnshang dào xiànzài, yǐjīng xià le shí ge xiǎoshí de yǔ le.
examples.english: From last night until now, it has already rained for ten hours.

examples.chinese: 晚上的風很舒服，我們一起出去走走吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang de fēng hěn shūfu, wǒmen yìqǐ chūqù zǒuzou ba.
examples.english: The evening wind is very comfortable; let's go out for a walk together.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上的風雨聲好可怕，讓我整個晚上都沒睡好。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng de fēngyǔ shēng hǎo kěpà, ràng wǒ zhěnggè wǎnshàng dōu méi shuì hǎo.
examples.english: Last night the sound of wind and rain was so scary that it kept me from sleeping well the whole night.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le. Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english: My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m. Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

items.wordHook: 晚(evening) + 上(above) → the evening sky above: 晚上(evening; night).

examples.chinese: 我要坐飛機到英國去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zuò fēijī dào Yīngguó qù.
examples.english: I want to take an airplane to England.

examples.chinese: 你看，飛機起飛了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, fēijī qǐfēi le!
examples.english: Look, the airplane has taken off!

examples.chinese: 機場附近的風景也很漂亮，我常常去看風景、看飛機。
examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng fùjìn de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliang, wǒ chángcháng qù kàn fēngjǐng, kàn fēijī.
examples.english: The scenery near the airport is beautiful; I often go there to see the view and watch the planes.

examples.chinese: 十點了，飛機快(要)起飛了。
examples.pinyin: Shí diǎn le, fēijī kuài (yào) qǐfēi le.
examples.english: It's ten o'clock; the plane is about to take off.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 他不是壞人，你不要怕他。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú shì huàirén, nǐ búyào pà tā.
examples.english: He is not a bad person; don't be afraid of him.

examples.chinese: 吃太多餅乾、薯條，只有壞處沒有好處。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō bǐnggān, shǔtiáo, zhǐ yǒu huàichù méiyǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Eating too many cookies and French fries has only disadvantages and no benefits.

examples.chinese: 吃太多餅乾、薯條，只有壞處沒有好處。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō bǐnggān, shǔtiáo, zhǐ yǒu huàichù méiyǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Eating too many cookies and French fries has only disadvantages and no benefits.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 小歐為了省錢，整個月都吃泡麵，最後吃壞了身體，吃藥、住院花了更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Ōu wèile shěng qián, zhěngge yuè dōu chī pàomiàn, zuìhòu chī huài le shēntǐ, chī yào, zhùyuàn huā le gèng duō qián.
examples.english: In order to save money, Xiao Ou ate instant noodles for a whole month; in the end, he ruined his health, and spent even more money on medicine and hospitalization.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西。颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi, cóng bù pòhuài jiālǐ de dōngxī. Táifēng kuài lái le, pòhuài le wǒ běnlái yào qù lùyíng de jìhuà.
examples.english: Our dog is very well-behaved and never destroys things in the house. The typhoon is coming soon, and it destroyed my original plan to go camping.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 我承認你的照相機是被我弄壞的，我一定負責把它修理好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ de zhàoxiàngjī shì bèi wǒ nòng huài de, wǒ yīdìng fùzé bǎ tā xiūlǐ hǎo.
examples.english: I admit that your camera was broken by me; I will definitely take responsibility for fixing it.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ máng bú guòlái de shíhou jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāngmáng, bié ràng zìjǐ lèihuài le.
examples.english: When you are too busy to manage, you should find someone to help; don't let yourself get exhausted.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 因為冰箱壞了，裡面的食物除了雞蛋、蘋果，其他的都腐敗了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi bīngxiāng huài le, lǐmiàn de shíwù chúle jīdàn, píngguǒ, qítā de dōu fǔbài le.
examples.english: Because the refrigerator broke, the food inside, except for the eggs and apples, all rotted.

examples.chinese: 在我們學校，上課時是不能使用手機的，連老師也不能破壞規定。那所學校規定學生不能帶手機上學，是希望他們專心學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒmen xuéxiào, shàngkè shí shì bù néng shǐyòng shǒujī de, lián lǎoshī yě bù néng pòhuài guīdìng. Nà suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng bù néng dài shǒujī shàngxué, shì xīwàng tāmen zhuānxīn xuéxí.
examples.english: At our school, you cannot use mobile phones during class—even teachers cannot break the rule. That school stipulates that students cannot bring mobile phones to school because it hopes they will concentrate on their studies.

examples.chinese: 冰店的生意好壞得看季節，冬天的生意總是不如夏天。
examples.pinyin: Bīngdiàn de shēngyì hǎohuài děi kàn jìjié, dōngtiān de shēngyì zǒngshì bùrú xiàtiān.
examples.english: Whether a shaved ice shop's business is good or bad depends on the season; business in winter is always not as good as in summer.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 茶樹的葉子沒有被破壞的話，做出來的茶葉品質都比較好。
examples.pinyin: Cháshù de yèzi méiyǒu bèi pòhuài de huà, zuò chūlái de cháyè pǐnzhì dōu bǐjiào hǎo.
examples.english: If the leaves of the tea tree have not been damaged, the quality of the tea leaves produced is generally better.

examples.chinese: 他把我的手機壓壞了，我要他買一支賠我。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ de shǒujī yā huài le, wǒ yào tā mǎi yī zhī péi wǒ.
examples.english: He pressed my phone and broke it; I want him to buy one to compensate me.

examples.chinese: 人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi pòhuài le zìrán, jiù shì pòhuài le zìjǐ de shēnghuó huánjìng.
examples.english: When humans destroy nature, they are destroying their own living environment.

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，很多電線被強風吹壞了，需要幾天才能恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guò hòu, hěn duō diànxiàn bèi qiángfēng chuī huài le, xūyào jǐ tiān cái néng huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: After the typhoon, many power lines were damaged by strong winds and will need several days to return to normal.

examples.chinese: 本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
examples.pinyin: Běndì shèqū de fángzi cháng bèi hàoqí de guānguāngkè pòhuài, lìng rénmen shífēn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Houses in the local community are often damaged by curious tourists, which makes people very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 這部電腦的鍵盤有幾個鍵壞了，我得找人修理它。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànnǎo de jiànpán yǒu jǐ ge jiàn huài le, wǒ děi zhǎo rén xiūlǐ tā.
examples.english: Several keys on this computer's keyboard are broken; I need to find someone to repair it.

examples.chinese: 為了發展工業而不斷開發，這樣下去森林早晚會被破壞光的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gōngyè ér bùduàn kāifā, zhèyàng xiàqù sēnlín zǎowǎn huì bèi pòhuài guāng de.
examples.english: Developing industry by constantly exploiting resources, if this continues, the forests will sooner or later be completely destroyed.

examples.chinese: 這家博物館曾因戰爭而被破壞，如今總算重新開放參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn céng yīn zhànzhēng ér bèi pòhuài, rújīn zǒngsuàn chóngxīn kāifàng cānguān.
examples.english: This museum was once destroyed because of war, and nowadays it has finally reopened for visits.

examples.chinese: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāihuài le xīn mǎi de shǒujī, yīncǐ nánguò de yàomìng.
examples.english: He accidentally dropped and broke his newly bought cell phone, so he was extremely upset.

examples.chinese: 歡迎你們到我家來，請進。
examples.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐmen dào wǒ jiā lái, qǐng jìn.
examples.english: Welcome to my home, please come in.

examples.chinese: 外面很冷，請進來吧！
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn lěng, qǐng jìnlái ba!
examples.english: It's very cold outside; please come in!

examples.chinese: 他們在裡面談話，你現在不要進去。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài lǐmiàn tánhuà, nǐ xiànzài búyào jìnqù.
examples.english: They are talking inside; don't go in now.

examples.chinese: 你這學期的成績進步了，太好了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè xuéqī de chéngjī jìnbù le, tài hǎo le!
examples.english: Your grades this semester have improved; that's great!

examples.chinese: 姐姐每天晚上都讀書，她進步了很多。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, tā jìnbù le hěn duō.
examples.english: My older sister studies every evening; she has improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì de shēngyì fēicháng hǎo, yīnwèi tāmen jìn le hěn duō tèbié de língshí, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xiǎng chángchang kàn.
examples.english: That supermarket's business is very good because they have stocked many special snacks; both adults and children want to taste them.

examples.chinese: 金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le. Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.
examples.english: When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic. This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close.

examples.chinese: 現在的科技很進步，萬一迷了路，就可以利用網路地圖找到回家的路。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì hěn jìnbù, wànyī mí le lù, jiù kěyǐ lìyòng wǎnglù dìtú zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù.
examples.english: Technology is very advanced now; in case you get lost, you can use online maps to find the way home.

examples.chinese: 路旁有很多小白花，我常常摘一些放在書桌上，看著看著心情就愉快了。進辦公室前，別忘了摘下帽子，這是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Lù páng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo bái huā, wǒ chángcháng zhāi yīxiē fàng zài shūzhuō shàng, kàn zhe kàn zhe xīnqíng jiù yúkuài le. Jìn bàngōngshì qián, bié wàng le zhāi xià màozi, zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: There are many small white flowers by the roadside; I often pick some and put them on my desk, and as I look at them, my mood becomes cheerful. Before entering the office, don't forget to take off your hat; this is a kind of courtesy.

examples.chinese: 小李進公司的頭三個月，每天上班要花兩個小時，後來搬到公司附近，走路十分鐘就到了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jìn gōngsī de tóu sān ge yuè, měi tiān shàngbān yào huā liǎng ge xiǎoshí, hòulái bān dào gōngsī fùjìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: For the first three months after Xiao Li joined the company, it took him two hours to commute every day; later he moved near the company, and it took only ten minutes to walk there.

examples.chinese: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ fēicháng yǒumíng de dàxué měi nián zhǐ lùqǔ yīqiān míng xīnshēng, chúle děi chéngjì gòu hǎo, hái xūyào yīdiǎnr yùnqi cái jìn de qù.
examples.english: That very famous university only admits one thousand new students each year; besides needing good enough grades, you also need a bit of luck to get in.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 只要照溫老師安排的課程，多閱讀、多練習，你的中文就會有很大的進步。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào zhào Wēn lǎoshī ānpái de kèchéng, duō yuèdú, duō liànxí, nǐ de Zhōngwén jiù huì yǒu hěn dà de jìnbù.
examples.english: As long as you follow the curriculum arranged by Teacher Wen, read more and practice more, your Chinese will make great progress.

examples.chinese: 剛進公司的員工對環境比較陌生，對工作內容也不熟悉，多多少少需要協助。
examples.pinyin: Gāng jìn gōngsī de yuángōng duì huánjìng bǐjiào mòshēng, duì gōngzuò nèiróng yě bù shúxī, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào xiézhù.
examples.english: Employees who have just joined the company are relatively unfamiliar with the environment and are also not familiar with the work content, so they more or less need assistance.

examples.chinese: 「總統」是國家最高領導人，他領導全國民眾往前走，讓國家越來越進步。
examples.pinyin: 「Zǒngtǒng」 shì guójiā zuìgāo lǐngdǎorén, tā lǐngdǎo quánguó mínzhòng wǎng qián zǒu, ràng guójiā yuè lái yuè jìnbù.
examples.english: The "president" is the highest leader of the country; he leads the people of the whole nation forward, making the country more and more progressive.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 許多國家因為工業進步得太快，反而使得農業慢慢不被重視了。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō guójiā yīnwèi gōngyè jìnbù de tài kuài, fǎn'ér shǐde nóngyè mànmàn bù bèi zhòngshì le.
examples.english: Because industry in many countries progressed too quickly, it instead made agriculture gradually not be valued.

examples.chinese: 孔先生學法律，不但是為了當好律師，也是為了保護家人。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānsheng xué fǎlǜ, bùdàn shì wèile dāng hǎo lǜshī, yě shì wèile bǎohù jiārén.
examples.english: Mr. Kong studies law not only to become a good lawyer but also to protect his family.

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.
examples.english: Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得那部電影很爛，我們就走吧，又不是非看不可。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde nà bù diànyǐng hěn làn, wǒmen jiù zǒu ba, yòu bù shì fēi kàn bùkě.
examples.english: If you think that movie is really lousy, let's leave; it's not like we absolutely have to watch it.

examples.chinese: 有些國家機場對攜帶物品的規定很嚴，出國前最好了解清楚。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā jīchǎng duì xiédài wùpǐn de guīdìng hěn yán, chūguó qián zuìhǎo liǎojiě qīngchu.
examples.english: Some countries' airports have very strict regulations on carried items; before going abroad, it's best to understand them clearly.

examples.chinese: 部分大學科系對學生成績的要求非常高，畢業條件也較嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Bùfèn dàxué kēxì duì xuéshēng chéngjì de yāoqiú fēicháng gāo, bìyè tiáojiàn yě jiào yángé.
examples.english: Some university departments have very high requirements for student grades, and graduation conditions are also stricter.

examples.chinese: 為了使客戶安心使用，我們公司產品訂了嚴格的生產標準。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ kèhù ānxīn shǐyòng, wǒmen gōngsī chǎnpǐn dìng le yángé de shēngchǎn biāozhǔn.
examples.english: In order to let customers use them with peace of mind, our company has set strict production standards for its products.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
examples.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

examples.chinese: 開車時萬一發生車禍，千萬要冷靜，以免情況更嚴重。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē shí wànyī fāshēng chēhuò, qiānwàn yào lěngjìng, yǐmiǎn qíngkuàng gèng yánzhòng.
examples.english: If a car accident happens while driving, one must by all means stay calm, so as to avoid the situation becoming more serious.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠的設備及員工都嚴重缺乏，哪裡有辦法進一步發展？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de shèbèi jí yuángōng dōu yánzhòng quēfá, nǎlǐ yǒu bànfǎ jìnyībù fāzhǎn?
examples.english: That factory is severely lacking in both equipment and employees; how could there be any way to develop further?

examples.chinese: 中國與美國之間的貿易問題很嚴重，這個新聞早就上電視了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǔ Měiguó zhījiān de màoyì wèntí hěn yánzhòng, zhège xīnwén zǎo jiù shàng diànshì le.
examples.english: The trade issue between China and the United States is very serious; this news appeared on TV long ago.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院昨天半夜發生嚴重的火災，受傷的人數約有三十名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn zuótiān bànyè fāshēng yánzhòng de huǒzāi, shòushāng de rénshù yuē yǒu sānshí míng.
examples.english: This hospital had a serious fire in the middle of the night yesterday; the number of people injured was about thirty.

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!
examples.english: That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qiángliè dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng de zāiqíng, búdàn xǔduō fángwū tā le, lián qiáo yě duàn le.
examples.english: This strong earthquake caused severe damage due to the disaster; not only did many houses collapse, but even bridges broke.

examples.chinese: 弟弟感冒了，可是他不但不吃藥，還一連吃了三碗冰，結果咳嗽咳得越來越嚴重了。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi gǎnmào le, kěshì tā búdàn bù chī yào, hái yíliàn chī le sān wǎn bīng, jiéguǒ késou ké de yuèláiyuè yánzhòng le.
examples.english: My younger brother caught a cold, but not only did he not take medicine, he even ate three bowls of ice cream in a row; as a result, his cough became more and more serious.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 隨著空氣被汙染的情況越來越嚴重，得到癌症的機會也增加了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kōngqì bèi wūrǎn de qíngkuàng yuèláiyuè yánzhòng, dédào áizhèng de jīhuì yě zēngjiā le.
examples.english: As the situation of air pollution becomes more and more serious, the chance of getting cancer has also increased.

examples.chinese: 為了安全起見，颱風天到山區露營的行為是被嚴格禁止的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile ānquán qǐjiàn, táifēng tiān dào shānqū lùyíng de xíngwéi shì bèi yángé jìnzhǐ de.
examples.english: For the sake of safety, camping in mountainous areas on typhoon days is strictly prohibited.

examples.chinese: 傳統私立高中有許多規定，在管理學生方面相當嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Chuántǒng sīlì gāozhōng yǒu xǔduō guīdìng, zài guǎnlǐ xuéshēng fāngmiàn xiāngdāng yángé.
examples.english: Traditional private high schools have many rules and are quite strict in terms of managing students.

examples.chinese: 這項規定是由大會成員一起討論後決定的，必須嚴格遵守。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng shì yóu dàhuì chéngyuán yīqǐ tǎolùn hòu juédìng de, bìxū yángé zūnshǒu.
examples.english: This regulation was decided after discussion by the assembly members together, and must be strictly followed.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，我不小心拿了你的書？ B:原來書在你這裡，我剛才在教室裡找了好久。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn ná le nǐ de shū? B: Yuánlái shū zài nǐ zhèlǐ, wǒ gāngcái zài jiàoshì lǐ zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ.
examples.english: A: Sorry, I accidentally took your book? B: It turns out the book is here with you; I was looking in the classroom for a long time just now.

examples.chinese: 原來是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì shí'èr shēngxiào, zhēnde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: Oh! You are talking about the Chinese animal zodiac! It’s really interesting.

examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

items.wordHook: Spelunkers explore a deep 穴(cave) through 九(nine) twisting subterranean tunnels to thoroughly 究(dig into) the earth.
Managing operational 經(the classics) through allotted 費(fee): 經費 means funds, outlay.
飯(meal) + 店(shop) → a meal shop → in Taiwan 飯店 also means hotel.
Combining 饅(steamed buns) and 頭(the first): 饅頭 means steamed bun.
